title: Police Blotter: 17 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County jail in this end-of-day roundup covering arrests from Sunday, November 1, into Monday, November 2, 2026, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records. The charges below are allegations, and each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.
content:
Seventeen people were booked into the Webb County jail in this end-of-day roundup, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records. The entries below cover arrests from Sunday, November 1, into Monday, November 2, 2026.

The charges listed below are allegations. Each person named is presumed innocent until proven guilty in court.

SANCHEZ, CRISTIAN XAVIER

SANCHEZ, CRISTIAN XAVIER was arrested on Sunday, November 1, 2026, at 1:18 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana, 2 ounces or less, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

MARTINEZ, ABRAHAM

MARTINEZ, ABRAHAM was arrested on Sunday, November 1, 2026, at 2:27 p.m. by the Department of Public Safety on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

DE LA GARZA, JAVIER

DE LA GARZA, JAVIER was arrested on Sunday, November 1, 2026, at 8:20 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury, family violence, a Class A misdemeanor, and resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

RIVAS-MEDINA, JOSE DE JESUS

RIVAS-MEDINA, JOSE DE JESUS was arrested on Sunday, November 1, 2026, at 10:54 p.m. by the Webb County Sheriff's Office on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated / open alcohol container, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

MARTINEZ, JUAN

MARTINEZ, JUAN was arrested on Sunday, November 1, 2026, at 11:26 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor, and public intoxication, a Class C misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

ANGUIANO, RUBEN

ANGUIANO, RUBEN was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 12:31 a.m. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was arrested on an alleged charge of public intoxication, a Class C misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

REYES, ALEJANDRO

REYES, ALEJANDRO was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 1:50 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on alleged charges of public intoxication, a Class C misdemeanor, and criminal mischief $100 to under $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $100 and $1,000.

JUAREZ-JUAREZ, MIGUEL

JUAREZ-JUAREZ, MIGUEL was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 7:16 a.m. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was arrested on alleged charges of driving while intoxicated, 2nd offense, a Class A misdemeanor, and driving while license invalid, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond was set at $3,500 and $2,500.

RIOS, ANGEL

RIOS, ANGEL was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 9:38 a.m. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was arrested on an alleged charge of possession of marijuana, under 2 ounces, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

SALINAS, JAVIER ARMANDO

SALINAS, JAVIER ARMANDO was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 2:21 p.m. by the United States Marshals on an alleged federal violation, and is held on a federal / Bureau of Prisons hold. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

REYES, JOSE LUIS

REYES, JOSE LUIS was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 5:29 p.m. by Border Patrol on alleged charges of reentry of a deported alien (18 USC 1326, federal violation), possession of marijuana, 2 ounces or less, a Class B misdemeanor, failure to identify, giving false/fictitious information, a Class A misdemeanor, and evading arrest/detention, a Class A misdemeanor. He is also held on a federal / Border Patrol hold. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

CORTES-ROSA, JESSICA MARIE

CORTES-ROSA, JESSICA MARIE was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 5:34 p.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of theft of property $100 to under $750, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

MARTINEZ, CARLOS GABRIEL

MARTINEZ, CARLOS GABRIEL was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 5:45 p.m. The arresting agency was listed as Out of County. He was arrested on an alleged charge of burglary of vehicle, a Class A misdemeanor, and is held on an out-of-county/state hold. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

CRUZ, MARIA GUADALUPE

CRUZ, MARIA GUADALUPE was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 6:25 p.m. by the US Marshals on an alleged federal violation, and is held on a federal / US Marshals hold. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

HERNANDEZ-CALDERON, PEDRO

HERNANDEZ-CALDERON, PEDRO was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 7:42 p.m. by the US Marshals on an alleged federal violation, and is held on a federal / United States Marshals hold. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

RAMIREZ, ENRIQUE

RAMIREZ, ENRIQUE was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 9:15 p.m. by the Constable's Office Precinct 1 on alleged charges of driving while intoxicated, 2nd offense, a Class A misdemeanor, and driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

GARZA, LUIS A

GARZA, LUIS A was arrested on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 11:03 p.m. No arresting agency was listed in the record. He was arrested on an alleged charge of harassment, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

Webb Watch 956 will continue to follow these cases as they move through the courts. Anyone with additional information about these arrests is asked to contact the arresting agency listed above.
